resources.string: An arrow that points magnetic north, true north, or Manhattan uptown.
This screen follows the phone while it is open. Each home-screen Compass widget keeps the settings you choose when you place it.
Long-press the home screen, choose Widgets, then North.
Declination is unavailable until the lookup succeeds.
True north looks up today’s declination from NOAA for your location. That repeats after about 20 miles or a week. Manhattan grid uses the same declination and checks location while the screen is on.
